about: Employer boards that listed at least one posting located in Taiwan on 2026-10-11. postings is the number of the board's postings located in Taiwan that day. Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards are read whole (countries is empty); a SmartRecruiters board is asked per country and names TW here. Nothing here is typed from memory: a board is in this file only because its live board answered scripts/board-seeds/validate.mjs on 2026-10-11 with at least one posting and passed the name check (scripts/board-seeds/report-2026-10-11.json; method and counts: docs/jobright-clone/market/BOARD_SEEDS.md). companyName is what the answer stated (Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters); Lever and Ashby state none, so it is the employer name the board id spells or a document confirms for it, and the board id itself where nothing confirms whose board it is (the note says which). postingCountries are the ISO codes its counted postings were located in. All counts come from location fields only and are those of that day, never a live number. A deployment loads the files of the markets it serves (seeds.ts): the mainland file and no other where GoApply alone is served, the international and the Taiwan file where RoboApply alone is, all three where both are. A board is ONE source there whatever file names it: countries is what it is READ for, and empty means the whole board, each posting landing in the market of its own location.
